title: Deterministic release baseline
userStory: As a portfolio maintainer, I can reset and verify the same fictional workspace before every demonstration so that release evidence remains reproducible.
businessRules: Two consecutive resets must produce byte-for-byte equivalent workspace snapshots.
Every declared demo fixture and database-seeded document link must exist and open.
Baseline evidence must identify its schema, fixture inventory, sample size, commands, and limitations.
nonGoals: This phase does not claim production availability, real-company productivity gains, or legal outcome quality.
This phase does not add a new contract-operations workflow or external integration.
acceptanceCriteria: Reset determinism, seed counts, file links, primary reads, exports, and invalid-input paths pass from one command.
The complete repository quality gate passes and the baseline evidence is retained in release documentation.

steps.rationale: The release baseline changes no operational D1 schema; it records and verifies the existing schema version 20.

evidence.ref: 15 fixture files and 9 seeded document links verified across two identical resets

metric.name: Consecutive reset equivalence
metric.value: 2 of 2 complete workspace snapshots byte-for-byte equivalent
